name: Crossroads Centre - Pasadena
summary: Crossroads Centre is a community shopping center located on Spencer Highway in Pasadena, Texas, managed by Brixmor Property Group. This well-rated neighborhood destination serves local residents with convenient access to retail services and amenities along a major commercial corridor.
demographics: Crossroads Centre serves the Pasadena, Texas market along the Spencer Highway corridor, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban communities. The trade area draws from households with moderate to middle income levels, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and value-conscious shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. Shopping patterns reflect a focus on practical, necessity-based purchases with regular visits for groceries, services, and casual dining, typical of a community-oriented retail destination in the greater Houston metropolitan area.
description: Crossroads Centre is a well-established community shopping center strategically located along Spencer Highway in Pasadena, Texas, serving as a convenient retail destination for the local community. Managed by Brixmor Property Group, one of the nation's leading owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, this center provides essential retail services and amenities to residents throughout the Pasadena area and surrounding Houston suburbs. The center's location along the busy Spencer Highway corridor ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for shoppers seeking everyday conveniences and services. With a strong rating of 4.3 stars from over 1,100 reviews, Crossroads Centre has built a solid reputation as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination. The center operates with extended hours to accommodate the busy schedules of local families and working professionals, making it a practical choice for routine shopping needs and services in the Pasadena community.
